title: On Putting the parcel on the top shelf
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：put　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 put 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the keeper ① put the parcel on the top shelf on the same day, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② puts the parcel on the top shelf before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ put the parcel on the top shelf at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ put the parcel on the top shelf before — a line in the calendar for January 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Putting the parcel on the top shelf on the same day, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ put the request in plain words before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Put the request in plain words at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ puts the request in plain words on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ put the parcel on the top shelf again when nobody else would.

⑩ To put the parcel on the top shelf, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody puts the parcel on the top shelf before dawn again and somebody must put the parcel on the top shelf on the same day all over again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1957 the keeper put the parcel on the top shelf on the same day, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper puts the parcel on the top shelf before dawn whenever the tower asks.
Putting the parcel on the top shelf on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever put the request in plain words before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower puts the request in plain words on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother put the parcel on the top shelf again, and the tower remembered that half.
